title: Lewis Structure 3D Bond Builder with Physics Debug Overlay
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive Lewis structure 3D bond builder with a physics debug overlay. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (0x1a1a2e) with ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (5,10,7) with intensity 0.8.
- OrbitControls for camera rotation. Camera at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin.
- A 3D grid helper (size 20, divisions 20) on the XZ plane for spatial reference.

## Atom System
- Atoms are represented as spheres with element-specific colors: C=0x333333 (radius 0.5), N=0x3333ff (radius 0.48), O=0xff3333 (radius 0.46), H=0xffffff (radius 0.3), S=0xffff33 (radius 0.52).
- Each atom has a text label (element symbol) rendered as a sprite above it.
- Atoms can be added by clicking buttons in a toolbar. New atoms spawn at a random position within radius 3 of origin on the XZ plane, y=0.
- Each atom tracks: element, position, valenceElectrons (C=4, N=5, O=6, H=1, S=6), bondedElectrons, lonePairs.

## Bond System
- Users select two atoms (click to select, highlighted with emissive glow 0x44ff44) and press 'B' to create a bond.
- Bond types: single (1 cylinder), double (2 parallel cylinders offset 0.1), triple (3 cylinders in triangular arrangement).
- Pressing 'B' again on already-bonded atoms upgrades single->double->triple->removes bond.
- Bonds are rendered as gray cylinders (radius 0.05) connecting atom centers.
- Bond length is enforced via spring physics: equilibrium distance = sum of atom radii * 2.2. Spring constant k=5.0, damping=0.8.

## Physics Simulation
- Simple Verlet integration for atom positions. Timestep dt=0.016.
- Repulsion force between non-bonded atoms: F = 2.0 / (distance^2) when distance < 3.0.
- Spring forces along bonds pull/push atoms toward equilibrium length.
- Atoms are constrained to y=0 plane (2D chemistry on a 3D stage).
- Total kinetic energy of the system must be tracked.

## Physics Debug Overlay
- Toggle with 'D' key. When active, render:
  - Force vectors on each atom as colored arrows (ArrowHelper): spring forces in green, repulsion in red.
  - Velocity vectors as blue arrows.
  - A semi-transparent bounding sphere showing the repulsion radius around each atom.
  - Text overlay (HTML div, top-right corner) showing: total kinetic energy, total potential energy, atom count, bond count, and whether the system is in equilibrium (KE < 0.01).

## Electron Counting & Validation
- Display a validation panel (bottom-left HTML div) showing for each atom: element, bonds used, electrons remaining, octet satisfied (yes/no).
- Octet rule: C,N,O,S need 8 electrons in bonds+lone pairs. H needs 2.
- Each bond contributes 2 electrons per bond order to each atom's count.
- Lone pairs = (valenceElectrons - bondedElectrons) / 2, rendered as small yellow spheres near the atom.

## Toolbar UI
- Top toolbar with buttons: [Add C] [Add N] [Add O] [Add H] [Add S] [Clear All] [Reset Physics]
- 'Clear All' removes everything. 'Reset Physics' zeros all velocities.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- atoms: array of {id, element, position:{x,y,z}, valenceElectrons, bondedElectrons, lonePairs, velocity:{x,y,z}}
- bonds: array of {id, atom1Id, atom2Id, order}
- selectedAtoms: array of selected atom ids (max 2)
- debugOverlayVisible: boolean
- totalKineticEnergy: number
- totalPotentialEnergy: number
- equilibrium: boolean (KE < 0.01)
- atomCount: number
- bondCount: number
- octetSatisfied: object mapping atomId -> boolean
- physicsEnabled: boolean (starts true)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Spring-based bond physics with Verlet integration (dt=0.016, k=5.0, damping=0.8). Repulsion force F=2.0/d^2 for d<3.0 between non-bonded atoms. Atoms constrained to y=0 plane. System reaches equilibrium when total kinetic energy < 0.01. Energy must remain finite (no NaN/Infinity). Bond equilibrium length = (radius1 + radius2) * 2.2.
